credits.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
credits.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

credits.title: Hired Gun
credits.overview: A hit man turns against his former boss after witnessing a nuclear weapon being smuggled into the US.
